scope: Acquire and audit observer-time DES photometry for a later exploratory time-dilation analysis. No exponent estimation or sample optimization in this pass.
exposure: DES events and published/derived timing results have already been examined; raw-photometry access does not create a blind validation sample.
data_policy: Read measurement times, fluxes, errors, bands, identifiers, pointers and documented redshift provenance; do not use cosmological distance moduli, expansion-derived ages or standard-cosmology simulations as observational truth.
No time coordinate is divided by 1+z during acquisition.
Measured wavelength matching through redshift is distinct from assuming temporal dilation.
SALT-derived peak times, amplitudes, classification and selection are methodological dependencies to audit, not automatically model-free inputs.
Do not execute downloaded analysis code; inspect it as provenance.
Keep large original products in ignored cache; commit pinned retrieval instructions, hashes and audit only.

Before inference, freeze sample cuts, wavelength matching, nuisance model, exponent grid, injection tests and event-level uncertainty resampling. Do not treat shared reference curves as independent events.
